# Animation dependencies

These are local copies of the versions previously loaded from external CDNs.
Keep them with the site's static assets so animation startup does not require
access to a third-party host.

| File | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `gsap-3.12.2.min.js` | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/gsap.min.js |
| `ScrollTrigger-3.12.2.min.js` | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.2/ScrollTrigger.min.js |
| `lenis-1.0.29.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/studio-freight/lenis@1.0.29/bundled/lenis.min.js |

GSAP and ScrollTrigger retain their original license notices in their headers.
